name: Video2PPT
tagline: Video2PPT is an AI-powered conversion tool designed to transform video content into editable PowerPoint presentations and PDF documents
description: Video2PPT is an AI-powered conversion tool designed to transform video content into editable PowerPoint presentations and PDF documents. By utilizing smart content extraction, the platform automates the tedious process of manually screenshotting slides from webinars, lectures, and training sessions. Users can process various video formats including MP4, WebM, and MOV, or directly convert online videos from platforms like YouTube.
